eyebrow: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform · Chapter 4
subtitle: Lesson 20 · Modules & Reuse

code:
version = "5.8.1"   # exact version only
version = ">= 5.0"  # 5.0 or later, including 6.x
version = "~> 5.0"  # >= 5.0, < 6.0
version = "~> 5.8"  # >= 5.8, < 5.9 -- patch only
caption: ~> lets the rightmost digit move, blocks the one to its left -- it won't jump to a new major version on its own.

code:
modules/storage-account/
  main.tf        # the resource blocks
  variables.tf   # every input the module accepts
  outputs.tf     # every value the module exposes
  README.md      # what it does, inputs/outputs, usage example
caption: Not enforced by Terraform -- a strong community convention, and what renders on a registry page.
